evidence: Both volcanoes officially quiet at image time: Kilauea ADVISORY/YELLOW not erupting, Episode 53 ended Aug 13, paused; Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting, arguing against fresh vog. [E1]
No FIRMS fire clusters in Hawaii box on 2026-08-15, only 48 pixels of Kilauea-summit volcanic thermal (summit glow, not fire), arguing against wildfire_smoke. [E5]

Transport story fails: wind FROM 286 deg (toward ~106 ESE at 7.3 km/h) vs measured plume drift toward 349 deg (N at 8.8 km/h, R2 0.57), ~117 deg disagreement, well outside 45 deg agreement, lowering confidence. [E2, E3]
Tracked source end at 19.365N, -155.72W is 17.0 km from Mauna Loa summit and 46.1 km from Kilauea summit, i.e. over/near the island, not extending from a clearly active vent given quiet status. [E3]

Very faint diffuse veil 20371 km2, 252 km long with land_frac 0.27 swallowing Hawaii; wind-based upwind end falls 173-207 km offshore to the west, inconsistent with tracked source end, showing mask/geometry unreliable for source attribution. [E4, E6]

evidence_cited.text: Both volcanoes officially quiet at image time: Kilauea ADVISORY/YELLOW not erupting, Episode 53 ended Aug 13, paused; Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting, arguing against fresh vog.
No FIRMS fire clusters in Hawaii box on 2026-08-15, only 48 pixels of Kilauea-summit volcanic thermal (summit glow, not fire), arguing against wildfire_smoke.

Transport story fails: wind FROM 286 deg (toward ~106 ESE at 7.3 km/h) vs measured plume drift toward 349 deg (N at 8.8 km/h, R2 0.57), ~117 deg disagreement, well outside 45 deg agreement, lowering confidence.
Tracked source end at 19.365N, -155.72W is 17.0 km from Mauna Loa summit and 46.1 km from Kilauea summit, i.e. over/near the island, not extending from a clearly active vent given quiet status.

Very faint diffuse veil 20371 km2, 252 km long with land_frac 0.27 swallowing Hawaii; wind-based upwind end falls 173-207 km offshore to the west, inconsistent with tracked source end, showing mask/geometry unreliable for source attribution.

classify.caveats: Mask swallows Hawaii island (land_spill) so geometry is unreliable; light winds ~7 km/h make upwind-end calculation unstable; measured drift disagrees with wind by >100 deg; both volcanoes officially not erupting and no FIRMS fires; haze is very faint.

kilauea.activity_summary: Kīlauea volcano is not erupting; the summit eruption in Halemaʻumaʻu is paused. Episode 53 ended at 1:23 a.m. HST on August 13.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in July, while the summit region showed patterns of slight inflation. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 57 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the July reporting period, after 94 in June. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
